meta.note: Annual indicators published by the World Bank. Values may lag current conditions; the latest available period is shown. Not a live or monthly series.

indicators.name: GDP growth
indicators.description: Annual growth in gross domestic product at constant prices.

indicators.name: GDP
indicators.description: Gross domestic product at current market prices.

indicators.name: GDP per person
indicators.description: Gross domestic product divided by midyear population.

indicators.name: Population
indicators.description: Total population, midyear estimate.

indicators.name: Inflation
indicators.description: Annual percentage change in the consumer price index.

indicators.name: International tourist arrivals
indicators.description: Overnight international visitor arrivals.

indicators.name: International tourism receipts
indicators.description: Expenditure by international inbound visitors, including payments to carriers.

indicators.name: Government expense
indicators.description: Cash payments for operating activities of the government.

indicators.name: Tax revenue
indicators.description: Compulsory transfers to the central government for public purposes.

indicators.name: Central government debt
indicators.description: Total central government debt as a share of GDP.

indicators.name: Exports of goods & services
indicators.description: Value of all goods and services exported as a share of GDP.

indicators.name: Imports of goods & services
indicators.description: Value of all goods and services imported as a share of GDP.

indicators.name: Trade openness
indicators.description: Sum of exports and imports of goods and services as a share of GDP.

indicators.name: Current account balance
indicators.description: Current account balance as a share of GDP.

indicators.name: Foreign direct investment
indicators.description: Net inflows of investment to acquire a lasting management interest.

indicators.name: Personal remittances
indicators.description: Personal transfers and compensation of employees received from abroad.

indicators.name: Total reserves
indicators.description: Official holdings of monetary gold, SDRs and foreign exchange.

indicators.name: Domestic credit to private sector
indicators.description: Financial resources provided to the private sector by financial corporations.

indicators.name: Official exchange rate
indicators.description: Official exchange rate, annual period average.

indicators.name: Unemployment
indicators.description: Share of the labour force that is without work but available for work.

indicators.name: Life expectancy at birth
indicators.description: Number of years a newborn would live if prevailing patterns stayed constant.
